title: Torsors under torsion local systems are local systems
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and work on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $G$ be a sheaf of abelian groups which is a torsion local system, and let $T$ be a sheaf of sets with a free $G$-action such that the quotient sheaf $T/G$ is a local system. Then $T$ is a local system. Here local system means that the underlying sheaf of sets is a filtered colimit of sheaves represented by finite etale $X$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and torsion means that every germ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] at a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] is killed by some positive integer (the bound may depend on the germ).
